title: Find-RCPA Security for Tag-Reusing PKW
summary: Nonce-misuse-resistant AEAD enables tag reuse in generic PKW, but whether the key-commitment barrier to find-RCPA security can be overcome in the standard model or requires an idealized model remains open.

formal_statement.body: For a tag-reusing puncturable key-wrapping (PKW) instantiation obtained by using nonce-misuse-resistant authenticated encryption with associated data (AEAD) in the generic PPRF-and-AEAD construction, determine how to establish the stronger $\mathsf{find\$\text{-}rcpa}$ security notion despite the key-commitment problem encountered in its proof. Specifically, resolve whether this obstacle can be overcome in the standard model or instead requires an idealized model.

scope.domain: Security proofs for tag-reusing puncturable key wrapping instantiated by nonce-misuse-resistant AEAD in the generic PPRF-and-AEAD construction.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether the key-commitment obstacle can be overcome to prove find-RCPA security in the standard model or an idealized model is required.

citations.label: Puncturable Key Wrapping and Its Applications

progress.summary: The discussion identifies key commitment as the obstacle to proving the stronger find-RCPA security of the tag-reusing instantiation. It explicitly leaves open whether the obstacle can be resolved in the standard model or needs an idealized model.
citation_labels: Matilda Backendal et al., Puncturable Key Wrapping and Its Applications
